lastText: The Case Is ClosedThe Net ClosesNew Ending Discovered · 1 / 16THE LAW HAS ITS DAY: NO BARGAIN WITH THE PROFESSORThe trial lasts eleven days, and it is held in public, to the last witness, because you refused your brother's quiet arrangement. The names in the Professor's second ledger are read out in open court, and two Members of Parliament resign before the week is out. The Government is furious. The press is rapturous. You receive a short note from Mycroft, written in a hand that is noticeably less steady than usual. It says only: 'You were right, and I shall never forgive you.' The Professor goes down for life, and so, in due course, do eleven men of rank. He is remembered as the best mind in London and the most exacting master.
